name: Nextcloud
description: Files, photos, calendar and contacts on your own server instead of someone else's cloud.

afterInstall.text: Click Open and choose a username and password for the Nextcloud administrator.
Leave the database set to SQLite: it is the simplest choice and works well for a household.
Click Install and wait a minute while Nextcloud prepares itself.
Open Nextcloud always with the address shown on this page: Nextcloud only trusts the address used during setup.
Install the Nextcloud desktop or phone app and sign in with that same address.
